mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wishlists (member_id, post_id) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{postId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlists WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.subtitle, p.price, p.discount_rate, p.duration, p.max_participants, p.rating, p.review_count, p.like_count, p.city_name, p.country, p.lat, p.lng, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM wishlists w JOIN posts p ON w.post_id = p.post_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
